categories: Type C (Uniform Schengen Visa - Multiple Entry)
document.description: A valid multiple-entry Schengen visa or national long-stay visa grants visa-free, simplified, or electronic visa entry privileges to multiple non-Schengen jurisdictions worldwide.

unlocks.notes: Foreign visitors holding a valid multiple-entry Schengen visa do not require a Mexican tourist visa for stays up to 180 days.

unlocks.conditions: Valid multiple-entry Schengen visa (previously used in Schengen territory)

Citizens of countries requiring a visa may enter Bosnia and Herzegovina visa-free for up to 30 days if holding a valid multiple-entry Schengen visa.

unlocks.conditions: Valid Schengen visa (valid for the duration of stay)

unlocks.notes: Short-stay Schengen visa (Type C) holders are permitted entry into North Macedonia for up to 15 days per visit (up to 90 days total in a 180-day window).

unlocks.conditions: Valid Schengen visa or residence permit
unlocks.notes: Foreign nationals possessing a valid Schengen visa may enter, transit, or stay in Serbia without a visa for up to 90 days in any 180-day period.
